title: Osaka, Kyoto & Nara
dek: Five days on a food-first swing through Kansai: an Osaka crawl, a Kyoto temple-and-kaiseki stretch, and a Nara day trip — with the autumn-illumination anchor swapped out once research found it doesn't fall inside these dates.
verified: ⚠ Draft — Pass A (canonical/verified) and Pass B (local/authentic) reconciled 2026-08-19, re-checked for source-kind compliance 2026-08-20, and independently critic-reviewed 2026-08-20 (16 perishable facts re-fetched against their own sources; five drifted values corrected, one demoted to a flagged gap), then re-reviewed by a second fresh-context critic the same day (eight facts re-fetched — all supported — and the Tenryu-ji autumn early-opening window moved into the fact registry so it expires). Re-check before travel: the last KIX departures for the Haruka and the Nankai line against your actual landing time (no arrival time was given at intake), Kuromon Ichiba's and Nishiki Market's opening hours and closing days (no primary source publishes either), Kiyomizu-dera's regular admission fee (no primary or operator source publishes it — the figure in this guide is secondary-corroborated only), the USD/JPY rate, Houshoan's booking window and its seasonal course line-up, the Nara day-trip's last-train times, Wanaka's hours/address (official site certificate-blocked on repeated attempts), and the US State Dept travel advisory level for Japan (recorded Level 1 as an honest placeholder, not a direct fetch — travel.state.gov is bot-gated against every tool this pipeline has).
footer: Location facts sourced to official venue/operator sites where reachable; see Sources & further reading.

entry.visa: Visa-free for tourism, stays up to 90 days. No advance application needed.
entry.passportValidity: Japan's own rule only requires validity through your date of entry; 6+ months remaining is still the safer international standard to fly on.
entry.note: Assumed US passports — the intake didn't state a passport country. Complete the digital arrival/customs declaration via Visit Japan Web before landing (recommended) or the paper form on the flight.
